title: Open Dental Appointment Failure Rate
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opendental:appointment
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(appt_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by provider_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Open Dental appointment records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each provider name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize appt_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per provider name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Open Dental appointment data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
